title: Replace the notification switch with a template table
prompt: renderNotification in notifications/templates.ts is a switch with one branch per kind, and every new notification kind means editing that function. Turn it into a table: export a `templates` record, keyed by notification kind, whose values are render functions taking `(order, currency)` and returning `{ subject, body }`. renderNotification should just look the kind up in it. The text produced for the existing kinds must not change.
